# SeniQu — Indonesian Cultural Heritage Platform

SeniQu is the leading digital platform for Indonesian cultural heritage, bridging museums, art galleries, and historical sites with AI technology, immersive galleries, and secure Web3 integrations.

## Core Navigation

Use these primary entrypoints to explore the platform:
- [Homepage](https://seniqu.art/) - Main landing page showcasing current initiatives, featured masterpieces, and project goals.
- [Public Art Gallery](https://seniqu.art/gallery) - Browse historical and contemporary Indonesian artwork collections.
- [Curated Collections](https://seniqu.art/collections) - Deep-dive into thematic historical collections and cultural archives.
- [Marketplace](https://seniqu.art/marketplace) - Acquire digital art and support local Indonesian artists directly.
- [Community Forums](https://seniqu.art/community) - Connect with heritage enthusiasts, historians, and art collectors.
- [Nearby Museums Map](https://seniqu.art/nearby) - Find and explore Indonesian museums and cultural landmarks near your current location.

## AI & Interactive Features

- [AI Genre Identifier](https://seniqu.art/ai/genre) - Upload an artwork image and identify its cultural context and style genre.
- [AI Art Curation](https://seniqu.art/ai/curation) - Create and customize personalized virtual galleries using artificial intelligence.

## Technical & Legal Documentation

- [Robots Configuration](https://seniqu.art/robots.txt) - Rules for automated web crawlers and indexers.
- [Sitemap](https://seniqu.art/sitemap.xml) - Complete XML structure of indexable routes.
- [Terms of Service](https://seniqu.art/terms) - Platform rules, user agreements, and transaction policies.
- [Privacy Policy](https://seniqu.art/privacy) - Information on user data protection, cookies, and safety standards.
